games.name: Red Deer Rich · phone mode
games.notes: Play on one phone: the phone hosts the game, board on top with pinch / drag and a soft camera that glides to the action and eases out the moment you touch it, tabs along the bottom open a small sheet (swipe up for everything, down or tap outside to close), tiny dice icon + shake to roll, small QR in the corner so friends join from their own phones. Move to TV: scan a TV's 0-Phi QR (front door) or type the TV's room code, the phones vote (majority), the whole game moves to the TV and every phone becomes a normal TV controller with the same seat. Live v0.8 untouched. Before release: real-phone test over the internet, then show Red Deer Rich as Plays on your phone on the front door.

games.name: Lost Sock
games.notes: v0.2: smooth zoom-and-follow camera (active sock, projectiles, decoys, lit mines, then eases out), bolder socks and name tags, Mismatched Pair build animation (fabric bolt, scissors, paintbrush, word bubbles), bigger explosions (shock rings, smoke), new Fabric Softener Mortar (5 bomblets), Iron Airstrike, Hamper Landmine; AI uses them. Full AI match to win screen verified. Next: bleach bomb, clothespin sniper, static cling grenade, lint roller steamroller, sound, private table mode.

games.name: Demolition Derby
games.notes: v0.3.1: up to 4 Xbox controllers join alongside phones (A joins / starts / boosts, left stick steers, RT gas, LT brake and reverse, RB boost, D-pad picks car and boost, X armour). A small gear opens controller settings (swap sticks). v0.3: Justin's sedan (sedan_v02.glb) for every car, tinted per player, with armour still attached. Damage goes to whichever parts face the hit (front, sides, rear, corners, crush from above): glass shatters; the hood dents, flaps while driving, then flies off; doors and trunk swing on their hinges, then break off; a wheel can come off (up to 2 per car; the car drives slower and pulls toward the missing wheel). Smoke past half damage, fire under the hood near the end. Loose parts become debris you can knock around, then fade after about 14 s. Camera about 12% closer. The AI plans for the coming edge. Armour now plays differently: None = fast with quicker boost refill, Plates = tanky and hard to shove but slower, Spikes = big contact damage and grinding. Boosts: Ram = unstoppable double-weight charge, Long = steerable steady push, Hop dash = jumps (can crush). Smarter AI: flanks to hit sides, picks weak cars, pushes toward drop-offs, reverses out when stuck, brakes at edges. Next: real-phone test; None armour still wins least in bot matches.

games.name: Iron Stride Squad
games.notes: Dev build of asymmetric mechs, live Iron Stride untouched. Controller players get small fast Striders (twin-stick, MG, dash). Phone players get Titans: 6x bigger, slow, siege cannon, 8-missile barrage, stomp, with tap-to-walk and tap-to-lock map controls. Co-op vs drones and tanks. Every shot is tested against buildings. Next: real controller and phone test, a third-person TV camera, PvP.
